senses.gloss: f. pl. (= עֳפִי Dan. IV, 9; cmp. b. h. עָנָף, a. אִיבָּא, אִנְבָּא) branches, esp. dry twigs, spray-wood.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 44b:23">Ber. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ פרסייתא</he> twigs of Persian trees.
<cite ref="Chullin 105a:11">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>פתכא דא׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אופיי</he>) a bundle of twigs.
<cite ref="Gittin 61a:4">Git. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>שדי אופיי</he> (Ar. <he>אופי</he>) threw twigs down (which he cut off), and dates fell off (v. Tossaf. a. l.).
